abi.common: ECX is the concrete Board/GridSearchable address. Stack arrays below start immediately after the return address. Point is two signed DWORD coordinates. Output is a separate three-DWORD begin/end/capacity header.

fresh_board.minimum_board_mapped_span: At least through Board+0x2c18 to cover the fallback tile; broader state is not asserted initialized by this packet.

tile_world_premises.terrain_layout: H8=(0,0), F8=(0,2), E8=(0,3) are Ground; G8=(0,1) is Water; every other tile is Mountain.
tile_world_premises.H8_occupancy: A separate mapped one-entry pointer vector naming the mover. begin/end/capacity are P/P+4/P+4.
tile_world_premises.unmentioned_tile_storage: Mapped zeroed fixture storage, explicitly supplied world premise rather than a full original tile-constructor claim.

fields.+0xb0: DWORD 1, the team returned by registered GetTeam
fields.+0xa4: DWORD zero, empty property container count/size gate at Pawn+0x94+0x10
fields.+0x8ec/+0x8f0: DWORD coordinates 0/0 for mover; blocker uses 0/1

mover_world_premises.profile_interpretation: (team 1 << 4) | PATH_MASSIVE 2 = 18; Ground uses 16. Low-profile and blocker-team changes are declared controls; no definition loading or GetPathProf execution is claimed.
mover_world_premises.non_grid_property_path: Native helper0x23e140 builds the literal property query and calls0x493b0 on Pawn+0x94. Empty container gate at+0x10 follows its false return path without property lookup callbacks.

directions.method: Execute the original call-free initializer against pinned original .rdata inputs; do not leave direction BSS zero or supply model-generated query results.

callbacks.method: Execute original callbacks and original tile predicates continuously. World records are supplied premises, not expected outputs.

path_route_builder_scope.meaning: Directional-wall rejection still rejects the edge. After the native traversal predicate returns false, a neighbor is nevertheless admitted when both coordinates equal the requested endpoint. GetPath is a route constructor, not an ordinary movement-destination legality query: the wrapper does not call IsBlocked, the core does not perform the GetReachable stop filter, and no movement budget is supplied.
path_route_builder_scope.ground_Water_endpoint: Low mode0/full profile16 rejects Water in can_traverse, but GetPath to Water G8 admits it as the endpoint and can return H8/G8. That does not establish a legal ground-pawn move or legal stop on Water. Ground-path-to-F8-through-intermediate-Water is a distinct negative control.

external_runtime_boundary.required: Original PE data/code at preferred base; original direction initializer; FS:[0] registration scaffolding; zero-filled mapped world; finite separate successful HeapAlloc/HeapFree responses at pinned CRT caller seams. No original-game DLL or process is executed.
external_runtime_boundary.failure_policy: Unknown imports or unsupported original helper conditions fail closed. Allocation failure, exception delivery, arbitrary stale caches and malformed ownership are excluded.
external_runtime_boundary.GetPath_additional_static_initialization: Core0xcf410 creates four local hash-style maps through0xd1620, which reads original global table at VA0x821520..0x8215b8. These file-backed source bytes must remain mapped; this packet does not stub those constructors.

known_scope: Reconstructed query fixture only; original Board/Pawn constructors and GetPathProf are not executed. Runtime vectors and Rust comparisons are reported separately.

historical_label_correction.meaning: The shifted prefix and counted-occupant comparison use team, not UID. Historical sealed byte receipts are retained; their pawn-ID/no-team prose is superseded.

declared_variants: G8 Ground instead of Water; G8 one live player-team or enemy-team blocker; budget 1/2; unoccupied origin control; Ground/Massive profiles16/18. Every variant is independently fresh, single occupant per tile; no corpses/NonGrid/directional walls/status/items.
